title: Add trusted proxy and forwarded-header security controls
description:
Problem: loopback/HTTPS-sensitive security decisions currently depend on direct connection properties and can be ambiguous in proxied deployments.

Desired outcome: explicit, configurable trust boundaries for forwarded headers so request classification remains secure and predictable.

Scope:
- In scope: trusted proxies/networks settings, forwarded-header processing, and updates to loopback/HTTPS-sensitive checks.
- Out of scope: full multi-hop edge architecture support beyond initial trusted proxy model.

Acceptance criteria:
- Forwarded headers are processed only when trusted proxy settings are configured.
- Security-sensitive decisions (loopback checks, remote auth HTTPS checks) behave correctly in direct and proxied modes.
- Admin guidance documents intended deployment patterns and trust assumptions.

Validation:
- Add tests for direct localhost, untrusted proxy, and trusted proxy request paths.
- Verify no regression to current local-first behavior.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from security audit finding F-003 to make proxy trust explicit and testable.
